title: Policy Slider Intelligence — implementation
summary: Turn each policy slider into an educational tool: description, intended effect, likely side effects, uncertainty level, affected score categories and real-world examples, surfaced via progressive disclosure. Tracks all implementation stories for this epic.
acceptance_criteria: Every slider has all six metadata fields populated
Metadata is accessible in the UI without overwhelming the controls
Affected score categories reference real EPIC-003 categories
Uncertainty levels are explicit and consistently scaled
notes:
Scope (in): Per-slider metadata: description, intended effect, likely side effects, uncertainty level, affected score categories, real-world examples
Out of scope: Changing the engine's maths (EPIC-012); AI generation of explanations now (future; soft-linked EPIC-008/010)
